motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Settle, object lifts, email pill and the view-transition morph.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: 0.7s ease-out both; delay i*65ms + 120ms; from translateY(-36px) rotate(-14deg) scale(0.92), opacity 0
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: still-life objects drop onto the field and settle on load.

motion.name: still-lift
motion.value: transform 0.4s; translateY(-8%) rotate(-7deg) scale(1.08); tag opacity 0.2s, translate 0.3s
motion.purpose: Still-life object hover/focus, with white name tag.

motion.name: steam
motion.purpose: Steam rising from cup objects while hovered (tile or still life).

motion.name: morph
motion.purpose: Shared-element view transition from tile object to case-study object.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All motion, including settle and morph, off under prefers-reduced-motion.

narrative.northStar: The Quiet Page with Small Things on It
narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Quiet Page with Small Things on It"**

A designer-PM personal site at the craft level of Brian Lovin or Rauno Freiberg: well-set Inter on warm-grey paper, chrome reduced to type, hairlines and one deep blue. The writing still carries the reading parts of the page.

The small things are a set of hand-drawn objects, one per story (a gaiwan, a noodle bowl, a lanyard, a napkin sketch), drawn from above in flat gouache fills with one warm-brown ink line and a shared roughening filter. They now sit on colour fields. The page opens on a still life: all of them laid by hand on a square of accent blue. The work follows as tiles, each object large on a soft field in its section's colour. The page closes on the same blue field it opened with. Each object morphs into the head of its case study, which opens on the same section colour.

Light and dark follow the operating system. Dark mode is soft charcoal, not black, with deep tinted fields.
keyCharacteristics: 1120px page; reading blocks (quote, places, case study) held to 680px.
One sans family (Inter) for every page string.
Warm greys, one deep blue, and three soft section fields.
Colour fields are the only filled shapes; everything else is separated by hairlines.
Hand-drawn SVG objects as the sole illustration.
One authored moment (the still life settles on load) plus one interaction family (object lift on hover, morph into the case study).

rules.name: The Blue Bookends Rule
rules.body: The accent marks interactivity and focus, and fills exactly two fields: the hero still life and the closing contact block. Both use the same blue with the same white dot pattern. No third blue band.

rules.name: The Section Colour Rule
rules.body: Field colour is assigned by work group (Working, Building, Community) and follows the story into its case study. A field never carries text; titles and lines sit on paper below it. Object palette tokens never style page UI.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every page string is Inter. Nanum Pen Script appears only as handwriting drawn inside an SVG object.

rules.name: The Plain Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings are plain sentence-case Inter 600. The only additions allowed are the group's colour square and its item count. No small-caps labels, kickers, eyebrows or index numbers.

rules.name: The Wide Page, Narrow Reading Rule
rules.body: Grids and fields can use the full 1120px; any running prose or list stays at 680px or narrower.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: If two things need separating, use space first and a 1px `line` rule second. Never a bordered box or shadow on chrome.

rules.name: The One Moment Rule
rules.body: Motion has one authored moment (the still life settling) and one interaction family (object lift with field tint or name tag, cup steam, and the morph into the case study). New surfaces reuse these and add nothing else. All of it stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

dos: Do keep running text and lists at 680px or narrower inside the 1120px page.

Do give each new story its own hand-drawn object (flat fills, `ink` line at 2.6 / 1.6 stroke, the shared rough filter, its own palette tokens), a hand-placed spot on the still life, and a tile in its group's colour.
Do separate non-field content with whitespace and 1px `line` hairlines.
Do give every new field colour a dark-mode pair and keep `faint` at or above 4.5:1 on paper.
Do source every factual line from INTERVIEW-NOTES.md and show anything unknown through the Fill mark.
Do honour `prefers-color-scheme` and `prefers-reduced-motion` for every new token and animation.
donts: Don't add a third blue field or use the accent for decoration beyond the two bookends.
Don't put text on a tile field, border a field, or add shadows to chrome; only the objects cast shadows.
Don't invent a fourth section colour without a new work group.
Don't introduce a second page typeface or set page text in Nanum Pen Script.
Don't add photos, stock illustration, icon-font glyphs or decorative graphics; the drawn objects are the only illustration.
Don't put kickers, eyebrows or index numbers on headings or tiles.
Don't invent placeholder copy in plain text; unconfirmed content goes through Fill only.
Don't add new motion beside the settle, the lift and the morph.
